_source_note: Career stage, affiliation type, methods, ecosystem focus, sectors, open to, availability status and contact visibility are copied word for word from Table S1 (Appendix A of the build brief). Countries are ISO 3166-1 official short names (via the pycountry package). Languages are ISO 639-1 names (the two-letter subset of ISO 639, chosen as the practical list for a working-languages field; pycountry's full ISO 639 table also carries ISO 639-2/3/5 codes for thousands of historical and minority languages not useful in a dropdown). ES topics are CICES v5.1 Group-level names extracted from the official spreadsheet at cices.eu (Finalised-V5.1_18032018.xlsx), never typed from memory. Five "Other" groups and two pairs of identically-named Regulation & Maintenance groups recur across the Biotic/Abiotic halves of CICES v5.1; those nine are suffixed with their Section (e.g. "Other — Cultural (Abiotic)") so every stored es_topics value is unique. All other group names are verbatim.
